description: Organize your kitchen with the iDesign York Corner Shelf! Made of durable steel with powder-coated bronze finish, this shelf adds a classic look to your decor and will stay looking new for years of quality use. It's perfect for storing spices, glassware, mugs, utensils, dry food, produce, and more. Place it in the corner of your counter, desk, or vanity to save space. It is designed with three feet to provide extra stability. Measuring 13.5" x 9.75" x 5.5", you are sure to have space for all of your kitchen necessities in the iDesign York Corner Shelf. With iDesign by InterDesign, you can #LiveSimply every day.
